guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, cfg_reg is reset to default configuration values defined by HMAC_CFG_*_RESVAL parameters for listed fields and zeros for any remaining fields via default:'0.
When cfg_block is low and reg2hw.cfg.hmac_en.qe is high, cfg_reg is assigned the entire reg2hw.cfg struct, capturing all fields simultaneously.
In all other conditions (not reset and not the update condition), cfg_reg retains its previous value unchanged.

assumptions.claim: Parameter constants HMAC_CFG_ENDIAN_SWAP_RESVAL, HMAC_CFG_DIGEST_SWAP_RESVAL, HMAC_CFG_KEY_SWAP_RESVAL, HMAC_CFG_DIGEST_SIZE_RESVAL, and HMAC_CFG_KEY_LENGTH_RESVAL are defined to values consistent with HMAC operational requirements and produce a safe configuration after reset.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect reset defaults could cause wrong data swaps, digest sizes, or key lengths, leading to HMAC protocol errors or security weaknesses.

assumptions.claim: External logic must assert cfg_block to inhibit cfg_reg updates when it is unsafe to change configuration (e.g., during active HMAC processing).
assumptions.cond: when cfg updates must be blocked
assumptions.risk: If cfg_block is not asserted at the right time, a register write could corrupt the configuration mid-operation, causing incorrect HMAC computations or security breaches.

assumptions.claim: When reg2hw.cfg.hmac_en.qe is asserted, all fields of reg2hw.cfg must hold the intended, consistent configuration values for the entire register.
assumptions.risk: If reg2hw.cfg contains incomplete or inconsistent data (e.g., from a partial register write), the captured configuration snapshot may be invalid, leading to operational errors.

uncertain_points.claim: The cfg_reg update uses only reg2hw.cfg.hmac_en.qe as a gate, ignoring the per-field write‑enable bits (qe) for sha_en, endian_swap, digest_swap, key_swap, digest_size, and key_length. If software performs a partial register write that asserts only sha_en.qe (or any other qe) without hmac_en.qe, cfg_reg will not capture those changes, leaving those fields stuck at their previous (potentially stale) values.
uncertain_points.cond: partial register write to HMAC CFG fields other than hmac_en
uncertain_points.risk: Stale configuration values could cause the HMAC engine to operate with an incorrect digest size, endianness, or swap setting, resulting in wrong authentication codes, security bypass, or data integrity failures.

uncertain_points.claim: The reset initialization uses 'default:'0' to zeroize any fields of the cfg_reg struct not explicitly listed in the assignment. It is unknown whether the actual struct contains additional fields that require non‑zero reset values; if so, they would be incorrectly forced to zero.
uncertain_points.risk: If hidden fields expect non‑zero reset defaults, zeroing could cause functional misbehavior (e.g., disabled internal debug features, wrong mode selections).
